name: Slovenia Pavilion
summary: Slovenia will take a 342 m² small pavilion at Expo 2027 Belgrade, run by the public agency SPIRIT Slovenia on an estimated budget of €3.3 million, and signed its participation contract in Belgrade on 4 September 2026.

about: The Slovenian government confirmed the country's participation in Expo 2027 Belgrade at its session of 9 July 2026, with the economy ministry as coordinator and Minister Anže Logar authorised to sign the letter of intent. All activities connected with the participation are carried out by the public agency SPIRIT Slovenia. Slovenia chose a small pavilion of 342 m², and the total cost of its appearance is estimated at €3.3 million.

Slovenia plans to present its achievements in advanced technologies, the green transition, the circular economy, smart mobility, digital solutions and sports technology. The participation contract was signed on 4 September 2026 at the EXPO Playground at the Belgrade Fair by Serbia's Expo commissioner Jagoda Lazarević, Expo 2027 director Danilo Jerinić and Slovenia's commissioner Saša Lavrič, after a Slovenian delegation led by Deputy Prime Minister Anže Logar toured the site. The designer, builder and National Day date have not been published.
